r = requests.get('https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/mteb/leaderboard', timeout=10)
space_info = r.json()

# Get the models list from the space info
all_models = space_info.get('models', [])

# Search for Scandinavian models more thoroughly
scandinavian_keywords = ['swedish', 'danish', 'norwegian', 'finnish', 'nordic', 'scandinavian', 'sv', 'da', 'no', 'fi']

scandinavian_models = []
for model_id in all_models:
    model_lower = model_id.lower()
    if any(kw in model_lower for kw in scandinavian_keywords):
        scandinavian_models.append(model_id)

# Remove duplicates and sort
scandinavian_models = list(set(scandinavian_models))
scandinavian_models.sort()

print(f"Found {len(scandinavian_models)} Scandinavian models:")
for m in scandinavian_models:
    print(f"  - {m}")
EOF
